create_action_schema: create an ActionSchema with named inputs and outputs for an ActionEngine action definition
register_action_handler: register an action with a schema and async or sync handler on the ActionRegistry
call_action_async: call an Action asynchronously by sending its message to the attached wire stream
run_action_in_background: run an Action in the background and wait until it completes using asyncio
bind_handler_to_action: bind a sync or async handler function to an Action instance for processing
